$description: AVAN GROUP · A3.2 Component State Matrix · Semantic + Component tiers (W3C DTCG). Pairs with avan-color-tokens.json and avan-motion-tokens.json.

ring-color.$description: Bronze ring. The single, consistent focus signal across every component and theme.

ring-offset.$description: Gap between component edge and ring, so the ring reads as a halo, not a border.

disabled.$description: Floor for disabled controls. Never below 0.4 — must remain perceivable, just inert.

state-success.$description: Verdant. Confirmation flashes, success toasts, completed checks.

state-error.$description: Oxblood. Validation borders, error icons, destructive context.

transition-hover.$description: 150ms feel: hover color/elevation shift. Uses fast tier rounded up for the larger surface.

transition-active.$description: Press feedback — color darken, scale, shadow inset. Immediate.

toast-duration.$description: Success/info toast persistence before auto-dismiss (2–3s). Dismissable early; errors do not auto-dismiss.

shake-duration.$description: Error shake — a single restrained horizontal correction, not a vibration. Disabled under reduced motion.

button-press-scale.$description: Shared with {component.button-press-scale} in the motion set.

shadow-button-hover.$description: Elevation lift on hover. Resting buttons use shadow.1; pressed use inset.

skeleton-bg.$description: Base placeholder fill; shimmer highlight is bronze.300 at low alpha (see motion pattern.skeleton-shimmer).

empty-state-illustration.$description: Heraldic line illustration in muted ink; CTA uses action-accent.
